chassis.note: Half-width 1RU, 221 x 44 x 235 - the data sheet's "44 mm x 221 mm x 235 mm (1.75 in x 8.7 in x 9.25 in)"; the stencil master's outline is 220.6 x 44.0. "1RU (1/2 width), wall/desk/rack-mountable" - the brackets are not part of the face.

front-layout.note: POSITIONS ARE THE RENDER'S. telco.com 2025/12/340-device.png is square-on across but seen from about 22 degrees above (the lid shows), so the face is 134.5 px tall where its 730 px width says 144.6; rectifying the four face corners (44.5,95.5 774.3,95.5 774.3,229.5 44.5,229.5) onto the data sheet's 221 x 44 takes the foreshortening out, and every cage, jack, lamp, vent and legend is placed where it lands in that 10 px/mm image. The stencil master is not used for positions: it puts the ports on a wider pitch and 5-8 mm left of where the render has them (the same failure as its TM-3312 and TM-3348 siblings).

lamps.note: STS beside the CON jack with a pinhole after it, and PS-I over PS-E between the two blocks, placed where the rectified render has them. No document says what any state means; PS-I and PS-E presumably report an internal and an external supply (see the ps-e gap).

model.note: TM-340 data sheet (telco.com 2025/12), "Compact, Hardened, and SLA-Assured Carrier Ethernet NID"; the faceplate prints T-Marc 340.

ports.note: SIX COMBO PORTS: each number names an SFP cage (port-N) and the RJ45 jack under it (copper-N), one or the other in use at a time - "6 x 10/100/1000 Base-T or 100/1000Base-X Combo SFP ports". The Network pair (1/1, 1/2) and the Access four (2/1-2/4) are separate blocks under their own bracketed legends. The jacks are common/rj45-ganged-eth@1 turned 180 (lamp windows in the upper corners, green and amber in the render) on the part's 13.97 pitch, centred on each block as measured (57.55 and 112.6); the render's own jack pitch reads 13.6-13.9 at 3.3 px/mm. The cages are std/sfp-ganged@1 at the registry's 14.25 pitch on the same block centres; the render's cage openings read 14.0, which a 14.25-wide part cannot sit on without overlapping, so the difference is in the drawing, not hidden. The printed numbers sit about 2.8 mm left of their jacks, as in the render.

power.note: "AC 100-240 V, 50/60 Hz / DC -24 to -72 V (dual-feed)"; "Power Consumption Typical 25 W, Max 45 W", with no configuration or ambient stated. AC (TMC-340-z, -z-E) and dual-feed DC (TMC-340-2DC, -EW) builds. Nothing on the front is an inlet, so it is presumably at the rear.

sources.note: One data-sheet edition (2025-12), three vendor images of which telco.com 2025/12/340-device.png (about 3.3 px/mm across the face) is the most nearly square-on, a 2021 photograph of a unit (2021/03/340f.png) showing the same face, and the legacy NetZoom stencil "Telco Systems" (2022), master T-Marc 340 (CF). No installation guide is public.
